scenes.title: The problem
scenes.text: When something breaks at home, finding the right professional can be slow, uncertain, and difficult to trust.

scenes.title: Start with evidence
scenes.text: Fiakto starts with what the customer already has: a photo, a short description, and an approximate location.

scenes.title: Gemini assists triage
scenes.text: Gemini analyzes the available evidence, structures the request, asks focused follow-up questions, and highlights possible safety risks without pretending to diagnose with certainty.

scenes.title: Relevant local work
scenes.text: The result becomes a clearer opportunity for verified local professionals with the relevant trade and coverage area.

scenes.title: Private by design
scenes.text: Professionals submit private quotes. They never see competitors’ prices, and the customer’s exact address stays protected until acceptance and payment.

scenes.title: Accountability
scenes.text: Fiakto keeps consequential actions auditable. Gemini helps organize information, but deterministic rules and people remain responsible for identity, authorization, and money.

scenes.title: Built for the pilot
scenes.text: Our first pilot is designed for CABA and Greater Buenos Aires, with a nationwide architecture and a simple goal: turn real household problems into trusted, accountable work.
